name: Jaime Alonso
headline: I build fullstack applications and coordinate AI agent teams, from software architecture and databases to UI/UX and production monitoring.

points: Developed Welloop, a PWA that currently has more than 600 active users (production data, November 2026), with constant patches and updates using CI/CD and a Docker development environment.

Built an AI-native platform that has high security measures, payments, external integrations, notifications, team management (events and communications), as well as extensive role and user management.
Automated core development flows with AI agent tools and evaluation cycles.
Developed and published the mobile application of Mirto, a luxury clothing brand, integrated with Shopify and with all the company's services, for Android and Apple.
Developed the internal business operations application (analytics, notifications, factory operations, product stock and other external integrations).
Developed a Shopify plugin to synchronize catalogs between Mirto's international stores.

education.title: Higher Technician in Cross-Platform Software Development
